label: Preserve native amounts and historical denominations in per-asset holdings

postcheck.description: Scalar account fields removed and asset holdings available
postcheck.sql: SELECT to_regclass('public."FinancialAccountAsset"') IS NOT NULL AND to_regclass('public."AssetQuoteSnapshot"') IS NOT NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns WHERE table_schema='public' AND table_name='FinancialAccount' AND column_name IN ('currency','balance')) AS result
